tools.Name: Scientific Agent Skills
tools.Description: A comprehensive collection of 163 ready-to-use scientific and research skills for AI agents, covering fields like bioinformatics, drug discovery, clinical research, and data analysis.
tools.Use_Case: Transforming AI coding agents into 'AI Scientists' capable of executing complex research workflows, literature reviews, and multi-step data pipelines.

tools.Name: Crawl4AI
tools.Description: An open-source, LLM-friendly web crawler and scraper that converts web content into clean, structured Markdown, designed for RAG and agentic workflows.
tools.Use_Case: Converting complex web pages, documentation, and dynamic sites into LLM-ready data for retrieval-augmented generation and automated data pipelines.

tools.Name: Heretic
tools.Description: A tool for fully automatic censorship removal (abliteration) of transformer-based language models without requiring expensive post-training.
tools.Use_Case: Removing safety alignment or censorship from language models to allow for more flexible research, development, and control over model output behavior.
